title: QBR prep + renewal & support tickler
content:
Quick scratchpad for today — mix of prep steps, one-off follow-ups, and things to pull before calls. Keep this messy (notes to self)

Top priorities (today):
- Acme Retail QBR 4/7 (30m run-through with PM) — confirm graphs + build 1 slide w/ key wins and infra ask
- FinBank renewal check-in 4/15 — internal pricing ask ready (2-tier: hosted -> dedicated)
- Open support follow-ups: INC-4421 (latent tail spikes), INC-4502 (embedding mismatch)

Pre-QBR data pulls (to run now):
- Usage trend: tokens/day last 90 days (run dashboard query, save csv)
- Latency P95/P99 by route & model variant (hosted vs dedicated) — highlight any regressions since 2026-03-10
- Cost delta: top 5 routes by spend, show unit cost improvements after caching/quantization changes
- Error surface: top 10 error messages + corresponding ticket ids (link to support view)

Acme Retail talking points (what I want to cover):
- 3 wins: (1) Checkout assistant latency down 28% after batch tuning; (2) Fraud reranker improved precision by 6% per eval set; (3) Rolling fallback to smaller quantized model saved ~18% spend in March
- Ask: trial Dedicated pool for mid-May spike (2-week PoV). Need to confirm expected qps and seq len distribution.
- Risk: one SLA blip 3/29 (region us-west-2) — show mitigation (auto-fallback + quick restart patch)
- Success metric proposal for next quarter: target P95 < 350ms for interactive routes, cost/unit <= $0.0009/token for batched jobs

FinBank renewal checklist:
- Contract note: current expires 2026-05-31; renewal conversation 4/15.
- Finance prep: draft 12-month reserved pricing vs month-to-month hosted. Calculate 20/40/60% discounts for commit tiers.
- Security ask: confirm KMS integration timeline for Private deployment (they asked about HSM). DM infra to get ETA (Diego).
- Renewal negotiating points: 90-day price lock, rollout assistance (2 migrations), 24x7 on-call for first month

Support follow-ups (quick list):
- INC-4421 (latency tail) — flagged to SRE, need root cause update. Action: ping SRE on slack + request short RCA by EOD.
- INC-4502 (embeddings mismatch) — user sees drift vs last week; action: run sample compare, upload diff to ticket, cc PM for model-check
- INC-4560 (access permissions) — customer stuck to add new devs; ops request for temporary admin token. Create escalation if not fixed in 24h.

Notes-to-self:
- Email templates: take QBR slides skeleton from confluence and fill top slide with one-liner outcome + ask.
- Bring up "Optimize" recommendations (caching + quantization) — show projected $ savings for their top route. Use real numbers from optimize dashboard.
- For Dedicated ask: have fallback plan to hosted variants documented (list model variants that are binary-compatible).

Meeting prep checklist (30m before call):
- Confirm attendee list + roles in calendar invite
- Upload latest usage CSV to shared call folder + attach to calendar
- Quick dry-run bullet points with Aisha (5–10m)
- Ensure console graphs visible and defaults set to 90d window

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who owns the FinBank KMS thread? (Follow up with security)
- Estimate of cost dev for migration to Dedicated (ask infra for rough SOW)
- Add a short FAQ for Acme: show expected behavior when fallback triggers, expected latency change, and how to read token-level cost breakdown

Small templates & snippets (for copy/paste):
- Quick meeting follow-up (use after QBR): "Thanks for the time today — attaching the slides and action items. Per next steps, we'll schedule PoV kickoff if you confirm timing. I'll send the technical onboarding doc and connect Diego for security questions."
- Renewal outreach (email subject): "FinBank renewal check-in + tailored pricing options"

Quick timeline (this week):
- Fri 4/03: internal review of Acme slides with Aisha
- Mon 4/06: send pre-read for Acme (one-pager + dashboard links)
- Tue 4/07: Acme QBR (11:00 PT)
- Wed 4/08: follow-up notes + action assignment

Misc notes (loosely):
- Consider running a 10-min demo of auto-batching improvements — it's visual and shows immediate cost wins
- Capture one customer quote about latency improvement for case study (ask success manager to collect)
- Flag option to include a simple A/B of quantized vs fp16 on their top route (numbers + perf)

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into slides tomorrow.

-- Liam
